result:
All 179 broken images in `performers.json` are fixed and none point at the dead host anymore.

Root cause: those 179 records (ids 0–178) had `image` URLs pointing at `198.51.100.64`, a dead host — a typo/stale IP, since every other performer (2521 of them) correctly uses `198.51.100.69`.

Fix applied:
- 40 records (ids 0–39) had a `stashdb_id` → replaced their image with the StashDB fallback via `stashdb_mock.get_fallback_image()` (e.g. `https://stashdb.org/images/stashdb-0.jpg`).
- 139 records (ids 40–178) had no `stashdb_id` (fallback returns `None`) → repointed their image URL from `.64` to the correct working host `.69`, matching the pattern all other performers already use.

Verified zero remaining references to `198.51.100.64` in the file.
